crossRefs.note: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will…
But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the…
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
“Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light…

translations.web: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
translations.bsb: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
translations.kjv: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
translations.asv: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.
